confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from a search of the RBA site. The search result gave the 18 November 2026 rate of 0.6720 USD per AUD. I did not open the RBA page itself. Food and drink anchors come from one search of cost-of-living aggregators (Expatica/Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere, uHomes, Nomad.watch). Those figures are crowdsourced and differ between sites. Cocktail and wine are not from direct data. I set them relative to the roughly $7 draft beer price, at about 2x for a cocktail and about 1.9x for a glass of wine. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not check any listings. Tampa hotel prices vary a lot by season and by events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other mid-sized Florida and Sun Belt tourist cities such as Orlando and Jacksonville, with prices a little below Miami.
